item.title: Salvation Army Housing chosen to bring community housing to Geraldton
item.description: The next step has been taken in a project aiming to get rough sleepers and those experiencing homelessness into housing, with two dozen Geraldton homes allocated to the venture.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Candice Evans: From pools to trampolines, tips to help keep your family safe this summer
item.description: Consumer Protection has some timely summer safety tips for you to enjoy fun in the sun, including advice for pool supervision, safer bouncing on the trampoline and care around button batteries.

item.title: Snapshot in Time: The second railway station that many in Geraldton may not realise existed
item.description: Many people may not realise how many railway stations Geraldton has actually had in its history.

item.title: City of Greater Geraldton will honour Bondi victims in National Day of Mourning
item.description: Geraldton will honour the victims of the Bondi massacre during the National Day of Mourning on January 22.

item.title: Perth fishing protest highlights frustration in Mid West towns about demersal ban
item.description: Hundreds of fired-up fishers from around the State have taken to Perth’s streets, demanding a reversal of the Cook Government’s controversial demersal fishing ban.

item.title: City of Greater Geraldton prepares to vote on future of Beam e-scooter contract this month
item.description: The City of Greater Geraldton executive has recommended to give e-scooter hire operator Beam the green light for another six months, but with some significant changes on the horizon.

item.title: Geraldton names new captain as women prepare for country week title defence
item.description: Geraldton has named its 2026 CSBP Senior Women’s Country Week who will mount their A-section title defence this weekend in Peel.

item.title: Geraldton Water Polo Association Round 12: B52s treading nicely as competition begins to take final shape
item.description: The B52’s continued their dominance in the men’s and women’s A-grade competitions in the Geraldton Softball Association despite valiant efforts from Rats and Demons.

item.title: Geraldton softball round 12: Rams too good for Pi’s in another thrilling weekend of action
item.description: Geraldton Softball Association saw its usual suspects again prevail across the league in another thrilling weekend of action at Utakarra Park.

item.title: Jarrod Heath Edwards: Driver who hit 3yo boy in Geraldton and fled the scene sentenced on remaining charges
item.description: A Geraldton man already jailed for four years over a hit-and-run that left a young boy fighting for life has been sentenced on more charges related to the incident.
